core-lethal-hits.summary: When an attack with LETHAL HITS scores a Critical Hit, it automatically wounds. No Wound roll is made, so that attack cannot score a Critical Wound.
core-lethal-hits.definition: When an attack with LETHAL HITS scores a Critical Hit, you can make it automatically wound. No Wound roll is made, so that attack cannot score a Critical Wound.

core-devastating-wounds.summary: When an attack with DEVASTATING WOUNDS scores a Critical Wound, the target suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic. Excess mortal wounds are lost.
core-devastating-wounds.definition: When an attack with DEVASTATING WOUNDS scores a Critical Wound, the target suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic. Those mortal wounds can damage only one model; any excess is lost.

core-assault.summary: An unengaged unit that Advanced this turn can shoot using only its [ASSAULT] weapons. After shooting, it cannot start an Action until the end of the phase.
core-assault.definition: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can use Assault Shooting. Assault Shooting is available when the unit is unengaged, made an Advance move this turn and has one or more [ASSAULT] weapons. The unit shoots normally, but only [ASSAULT] weapons can be selected. After it shoots, the unit cannot start an Action until the end of the phase.

core-blast.summary: When gathering attack dice, add 1 attack die for every full 5 models in the target unit. [BLAST X] adds X attack dice instead.
core-blast.definition: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add 1 attack die for every full 5 models that were in the target unit during the Select Targets step. For [BLAST X], add X attack dice for every full 5 models instead. Example: [BLAST 2] against a 12-model unit adds 4 attack dice.

core-cleave.summary: When gathering attack dice, if all of this weapon's attacks target one unit, add X attack dice for every full 5 models in that unit.
core-cleave.definition: [CLEAVE] always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for this weapon, if you selected only one target for all of the weapon's attacks, add X attack dice for every full 5 models that were in the target unit during the Select Targets step. Example: [CLEAVE 1] with A 3 against a 16-model unit adds 3 attack dice, for a total of 6.

core-rule-04-03-resolve-attacks.summary: For each target, gather attack dice for one weapon and any identical attacks, resolve those dice through the Attack Sequence, then repeat for remaining weapons and targets.
core-rule-04-03-resolve-attacks.definition: Resolve attacks target by target. Select an enemy unit, gather attack dice equal to the selected weapon's A characteristic plus any identical attacks, resolve those dice through the Attack Sequence, then repeat for unused weapons against that target and finally for other targets.

core-rule-05-01-hit-rolls.summary: Roll one D6 per attack die: unmodified 1 fails, unmodified 6 is a Critical Hit, otherwise the result must equal or beat the attack's BS/WS.
core-rule-05-01-hit-rolls.definition: Make one Hit roll for each attack die. Apply the first matching result: an unmodified 1 fails; an unmodified 6 is a Critical Hit; a result equal to or greater than the attack's BS/WS hits; any other result fails. Critical Hits are still hits and can trigger other rules.

core-rule-05-02-wound-rolls.summary: Roll one D6 per hit: unmodified 1 fails and 6 is Critical. Required result by S vs T: twice 2+, greater 3+, equal 4+, lower 5+, half 6+.
core-rule-05-02-wound-rolls.definition: Make one Wound roll for each hit. An unmodified 1 fails and an unmodified 6 is a Critical Wound. Otherwise compare Strength with Toughness: at least twice T wounds on 2+; greater than T on 3+; equal on 4+; lower on 5+; half or less on 6+.

core-rule-05-03-save-rolls.summary: Group target models by CHARACTER status and matching W/Sv/InSv, declare allocation order, then roll one Save for every attack that wounded.
core-rule-05-03-save-rolls.definition: The opposing player groups target models: each CHARACTER is its own group and other models share groups when W, Sv and InSv match. Declare allocation order, prioritising wounded non-CHARACTER models and keeping CHARACTER groups after non-CHARACTER groups, then roll one Save for each attack that wounded.

core-rule-05-04-inflict-damage.summary: Allocate saves from lowest upward. Unmodified 1 inflicts damage; a successful InSv or Sv after AP stops it; otherwise lose wounds equal to D and destroy at 0.
core-rule-05-04-inflict-damage.definition: For each Save roll from lowest to highest, select a model in the current allocation group, prioritising a wounded model. An unmodified 1 inflicts damage. A result meeting InSv, or meeting Sv after AP, makes the attack fail; any other result inflicts damage. The model loses wounds equal to D and is destroyed at 0 or fewer.

core-rule-15-09-snap-shooting.summary: Shoot one visible enemy within 24 inches; attacks hit only on an unmodified 6, Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled, and the unit cannot start an Action afterward.
core-rule-15-09-snap-shooting.definition: When another rule allows Snap Shooting, the unit shoots using Making Attacks. It can target only one visible eligible enemy within 24 inches. Attacks hit only on an unmodified 6 regardless of BS or modifiers, Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled, and the unit cannot start an Action for the rest of the phase.

core-active-player.summary: Usually the player whose turn it is; outside a turn it is the first-turn player, with temporary handoff to a selected unit's controller while it moves, shoots or fights.
core-active-player.definition: At any time one player is Active and the other Opposing. Outside either player's turn, the player taking the first turn that battle round is Active. During a turn its owner is Active, except that a selected unit's controller becomes Active until its move ends or its shooting/fighting attacks resolve.

core-within.summary: A model is Within a distance when any part of its base is within it; unit-level Within needs at least one model within.
core-within.definition: A model is Within a distance when any part of its base is within that distance. A unit is Within when at least one model in it is Within. Measure from the Frame instead of the base when the Frame rule says so.

core-wholly-within.summary: A model is Wholly Within only when every part of its base is within; a unit is Wholly Within only when every model is.
core-wholly-within.definition: A model is Wholly Within a distance when every part of its base is within that distance. A unit is Wholly Within only when every model in it is Wholly Within. Measure from the Frame instead of the base when the Frame rule says so.
